description: This class defines search criteria parameters for querying encounters within the OpenMRS platform. It encapsulates various filters such as patient, location, date range, encounter types, and more, to facilitate complex search operations.

classes.name: EncounterSearchCriteria
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates search filters for retrieving encounter records in the system.

methods.name: EncounterSearchCriteria
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all search criteria fields.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with the encounter search criteria.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location filter for the encounter search.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date (inclusive) for the encounter date range filter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date (exclusive) for the encounter date range filter.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the minimum date that the encounter was last modified.

methods.name: getEnteredViaForms
methods.description: Returns the collection of forms that entered the encounter.

methods.name: getEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of encounter types to filter by.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Returns the collection of providers associated with the encounter.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of visit types associated with the encounter.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Returns the collection of visits associated with the encounter.

methods.name: getIncludeVoided
methods.description: Indicates whether voided encounters should be included in search results.
